### Reproducibility

- [ ] Result manifest and event log validate.
- [ ] Algorithm source/container is immutable and license is stated.
- [ ] Algorithm authors, controllers, tuners, and configurators are identified.
- [ ] Exact invocation, parameters, seed set, hardware, time, and memory limits are recorded.
- [ ] Internal objective and hard/soft constraints are disclosed.
- [ ] Prediction-data track, training/tuning data, and test-set tuning are disclosed.
- [ ] Relocation and acceptance/commitment policies are disclosed.
- [ ] Every required instance/lookahead/seed is present or has a visible non-completed status.
- [ ] No seed or instance was omitted because of an unfavorable outcome.
- [ ] No large result is called optimal without an objective-specific certificate.
- [ ] No aggregate score is proposed as an official scorecard field.
- [ ] The result standing, access disclosures, conflicts, and eligibility notes are complete.
- [ ] A hidden contributor reference is marked `contributor_reference` and `official: false`.
- [ ] An official hidden result has a frozen artifact, no algorithm-team pre-access, an independent controlled evaluator, and an access attestation.
